create_task.reason: Creating a task is a user-facing action suitable for Shortcuts.

complete_task.reason: Completing a selected task is idempotent and useful outside the app.

delete_task.reason: Deleting one selected task is eligible only with explicit confirmation; no deletion intent is generated automatically.

search_tasks.reason: Search should return task entities for use in another shortcut action.

change_due_date.reason: Rescheduling a selected task is an explicit user-facing outcome.
